name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
summary: Veyric Thunderhame asks you to gather twisted elemental totems in Arathi Highlands. He hopes to learn how other peoples practice shamanism and find a way to counter the quilboar's elemental working.

sections.title: A Counter-Ritual
sections.body: Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands needs your help after the quilboar flooded Thousand Needles. He says their use of the elements has stirred outrage, and a counter-ritual will require better knowledge of these twisted forces. A book describes how Azeroth's many peoples practice shamanism. Veyric asks you to bring him twisted fire, earth, air, and water totems so he can learn from them.

faq.q: Who is asking for the totems?
faq.answer: Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands asks you to collect twisted fire, earth, air, and water totems.

faq.q: Why does Veyric need the totems?
faq.answer: Veyric wants to understand the twisted elements as he works toward a counter-ritual against the quilboar's elemental working.
The quilboar flooded Thousand Needles, and Veyric says their use of the elements has stirred outrage.
The book describes the many peoples of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

faq.q: Which totems does Veyric ask for?
faq.answer: He asks for twisted fire, earth, air, and water totems.

angles.text: As a shaman, you are asked to help Veyric learn how peoples across Azeroth practice shamanism and understand the twisted elements.
